soil_health.name: Soil Health & Biogeochemistry
soil_health.description: Biological, chemical, and physical parameters governing soil function and nutrient cycles

soil_ph.name: Soil pH
soil_ph.ecological_role: Determines nutrient solubility, cation exchange capacity (CEC), and bacterial vs fungal dominance.

soil_organic_carbon.name: Soil Organic Carbon (SOC)
soil_organic_carbon.ecological_role: Core foundation of soil structure, microbial energy supply, water-holding capacity, and climate carbon sink.

soil_moisture.name: Soil Moisture / Available Water Capacity
soil_moisture.ecological_role: Medium for plant transpiration, rhizosphere solute transport, and subterranean organism mobility.

soil_fertility.name: Soil Fertility Index & CEC
soil_fertility.ecological_role: Available nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), micronutrients, and base saturation.

soil_degradation_indicators.name: Soil Degradation & Compaction Index
soil_degradation_indicators.unit: Degradation severity score (0-100, lower is healthier)

land_use_cover.name: Land Use & Land Cover (LULC)
land_use_cover.description: Spatial management, canopy structure, and land classification dynamics

land_cover_class.name: Land Cover Classification
land_cover_class.ecological_role: Defines macroscopic energy flux, surface albedo, evapotranspiration, and structural habitat layers.

agricultural_system.name: Agricultural Cropping System
agricultural_system.ecological_role: Directly controls plant genetic heterogeneity, continuous living root presence, and trophic support for arthropods.

habitat_fragmentation.name: Habitat Fragmentation & Edge Effect
habitat_fragmentation.ecological_role: Quantifies average patch size, distance to nearest ecological corridor, and perimeter-to-area edge exposure.

biodiversity.name: Biodiversity & Ecological Integrity
biodiversity.description: Species, genetic, functional, and community-level ecosystem health metrics

species_richness.name: Species Richness & Alpha Diversity
species_richness.unit: Count of native taxa / Shannon-Wiener Index (H')
species_richness.ecological_role: Number of co-occurring species within an ecological guild, driving ecosystem functional redundancy.

pollinator_diversity.name: Pollinator Diversity & Abundance
pollinator_diversity.unit: Pollinator Index (0-100, wild bees, hoverflies, lepidoptera)
pollinator_diversity.ecological_role: Enables reproduction of ~87.5% of all flowering plants and 75% of global food crops.

microbial_diversity.name: Soil Microbial Diversity & Fungal-to-Bacterial Ratio (F:B)
microbial_diversity.unit: F:B ratio (0.1 - 2.5) / Microbial Biomass Carbon (mg C/kg)
microbial_diversity.ecological_role: Governs organic matter mineralization, glomalin production, mycorrhizal networks, and disease suppression.

native_species_ratio.name: Native vs Invasive Species Ratio
native_species_ratio.ecological_role: Preserves co-evolved evolutionary associations, specialized pollination syndromes, and native food webs.

habitat_quality.name: Habitat Quality Index
habitat_quality.ecological_role: Composite measure of canopy strata, deadwood volume, leaf litter depth, and water access.

species_survival_indicators.name: Species Survival & Extinction Risk Indicators
species_survival_indicators.unit: IUCN Red List Categories (LC, NT, VU, EN, CR) / Population Trend Index
species_survival_indicators.ecological_role: Tracks population trajectory, minimum viable territory, and vulnerability to climatic shocks.

climate.name: Climate & Hydrological Dynamics
climate.description: Atmospheric variables, precipitation regimes, and extreme weather stressors

temperature.name: Mean Annual Temperature & Thermal Extremes
temperature.ecological_role: Controls metabolic rates, evapotranspiration demand, phenology, and thermal envelope thresholds.

rainfall.name: Annual Precipitation
rainfall.ecological_role: Primary hydrologic input replenishing surface waters, groundwater aquifers, and root-zone moisture.

rainfall_pattern.name: Rainfall Seasonality & Intensity Pattern
rainfall_pattern.ecological_role: Governs seasonal dormancy, germination triggers, and erosion energy (erosivity index EI30).

drought_conditions.name: Drought Severity Index (SPEI)
drought_conditions.ecological_role: Captures combined moisture deficit from reduced rainfall and elevated vapor pressure deficit (VPD).

climate_zone.name: Köppen-Geiger Climate Zone
climate_zone.ecological_role: Defines baseline ecological biome constraints, climatic envelopes, and native floral adaptations.

human_impact.name: Anthropogenic Pressure & Landscape Degradation
human_impact.description: Direct human-induced stressors, land conversion, and chemical loading

chemical_pollution.name: Agrochemical & Environmental Pollution Index
chemical_pollution.unit: Synthetic N-P loading (kg/ha/yr) & Pesticide toxicity load (ETI score)
chemical_pollution.ecological_role: Causes eutrophication in aquatic buffers, collapses mycorrhizae, and produces non-target pollinator mortality.

deforestation_rate.name: Deforestation & Canopy Loss Rate
deforestation_rate.unit: % canopy cover lost per decade / ha/yr
deforestation_rate.ecological_role: Destroys carbon biomass, interrupts biotic rainfall pumps, and drives severe local microclimate heating.

agricultural_intensity.name: Agricultural Management Intensity
agricultural_intensity.unit: Intensity Score (0-100, accounting for tillage, monoculture index, chemical inputs)
agricultural_intensity.ecological_role: Drives chronic disruption of biological cycles through repeated tillage, chemical fertilization, and landscape homogenization.

land_degradation.name: Land Degradation & Desertification Status
land_degradation.unit: Status (None, Slight, Moderate, Severe, Extreme) / Soil Loss t/ha/yr
land_degradation.ecological_role: Permanent decline in biological and economic productivity of rainfed or irrigated lands.
